scope: One plugin directory: manifest, check, and the evidence class on every vendor claim.
does: Keep a check that exits 0, 1, or 2.
Refuse a tested-class claim on a stub.
Require a tested-class claim to name a file that exists.
doesNot: Mark a design claim as tested because the manifest parses.

claims.text: A stub check that carries a tested claim fails, and an implemented check whose tested claim names no existing file fails.
The Amplitude and Fullstory directories currently satisfy this check: Fullstory is a stub with no tested claim, and Amplitude's tested claims name files in this repository.
